files.name: motion-prompt-054.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Tooltip" (ツールチップ), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #054

What it is: Hover over something to show a short label
What the sample shows: Hovering over a "?" icon shows a short note in a dark bubble above it; it disappears when the cursor leaves.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. A "?" icon (blue ring, radius 13) at (196, 121) next to a label.
- The cursor only hovers, no click: it arrives on "?" at 1.05 s, stays until 3.15 s and leaves the card by 4.1 s.
- Show amount a: 0→1 over 1.15–1.35 s with easeOutCubic; opacity a, rising 6 px into place.
- Bubble: #26282c, 184×36, radius 8, top at y 64, with a 16-wide, 8-tall triangle pointing down at the icon; white 15 px text.
- Hide: linear 1→0 over 3.25–3.45 s.
When to use it: Use it to add a one-line hint to an icon or abbreviation without taking space on the page.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/054.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
